notes.title: "TINY BUNNY" is now available in Japanese!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39662184/849c9649e9d34461b78ccb9d236b89f819187d14.png"][/img]

Hooray! The day has finally come! Friends, we have huge news![/p][p]After several months of meticulous work, our "TINY BUNNY" is now speaking Japanese! Now players in Japan, the birthplace of visual novels, will be able to experience the unique atmosphere of the 1990s Russian hinterland.[/p][p]Meanwhile, here's a fresh progress update on Episode 5!
[b]Completion rate: 88%[/b][/p][p]Later [b]THIS[/b] year, we will finally leave Early Access and release the full version of the game![/p][p]Thank you for staying with us! Your support inspires us to work harder every single day.[/p]

notes.title: DLC manga
notes.notes:
[p]The manga Love, Death and Strawberries is now available on Steam! Even if you are not in Russia and cannot buy the physical version, you can now read it digitally!

This DLC manga, related to the main story of Bunny, tells the story of Smirnova Katya. Through it, you will be able to immerse yourself more deeply in the gloomy atmosphere of our game. The story takes place between the third and fourth episodes of the game. 

In this manga you will see:
~ A gripping story of Katya 
~ New background details about the world of Bunny 
~ A tragicomic plot and unforgettable moments[/p]

notes.title: EP. 5 teaser released!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=5y80wZBH4UY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Enjoy watching!

✨Episode 5 is 80% ready✨
Hey there, everyone! It's a home stretch! Just 20% more 🤩 

 
We've been hard at work for a long time now. Episode 5 will be absolutely colossal! Counting all the endings, it's length will exceed the first three episodes combined! We've drawn a ton of new art as well since we needed a ridiculous amount of fresh assets for all the new exciting stuff that will conclude Tiny Bunny's story. 

 
✅ What's already finished and what you can expect

 
•  All of the new background images, from the blood-soaked forest clearing to the foreboding Magical Forest, have been finished.
•  A grim plot with blood-chilling twists and endings that will keep you awake at night… are also done!
•  All of the spritework, including new characters. Also there. 
•  We've also animated some of the CGs.
•  Most of the voiceover has already been cut and implemented.
•  Most of the new soundtrack, including new compositions, is also already in the game.

 
❇️ What's still on the to-do list

 
•  Some code-related work.
•  Some minor additions to the game's graphics.
•  Proof-reading.
•  Finalizing the achievements.
•  Finish recording new/updated lines for the voiceover.
•  Implementing the voiceover into the game.
•  Sound design work.
•  Implementing localizations.
•  Designing the game's credits.
•  Recording a few of the remaining songs.
•  Meticulous polishing of all of the game's aspects.
•  Testing and optimization.

 
We understand how painful the wait must've been for you all, especially when it's something you've been wanting to get your hands on for such a long time. Please believe us when we say that we also can't wait to show you the fruits of our labor. 

 
But keep in mind that this is not a game for the faint-hearted. We want to ensure that Tiny Bunny will be an unforgettable experience... or maybe even something that will haunt you at night. 
So we ask you to be patient for just a little bit longer. The story's final will surely be… something.

 
More updates coming soon.

notes.title: Episode IV
notes.notes:
Tiny Bunny EP. 4 "Stomp your hooves in wait" is OUT NOW!

Hello! Saikono here.
The long awaited EP. 4 is finally available!
This episode features major consequences of your previous choices, a lot of branches in the narrative, and a bunch of new mini games. 
We did our best to resolve the issue with your old saves not working, and they should work now, but if for some reason they don't, you'll sadly have to skip everything from EP. 1 manually.  My sincere apologies for any inconvenience caused by this. The team and I worked very hard to hold the bar of quality we've set in the previous episodes and sometimes even surpass that bar. I hope you'll enjoy the fruits of our labor. 
If you like our game, please tell about it to your friends and neighbors. We will be endlessly thankful for that.

We're also really happy to have such a great audience and hope you stay with us until the eventual release of EP. 5! Stay tuned and thank you for playing!

Написать @Aesthetic Dialectic

notes.title: Release date for EP. 4!
notes.notes:
Release date for EP. 4!
Episode 4: Stomp Your Hooves In Wait will be up on May 31st.
Everybody who already owns the game will get the new episode as a free update.
We've been working hard and listening to your feedback, so we've added a lot more new save slots for all your needs.
There will also be a "Set To Default" button in the options menu for the best audio experience.
Oh, and most importantly, due to the presence of extreme violence in Episode 4, it's not recommended to anyone younger than 18.
[previewyoutube=B3YM7c5hdc0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New language supported.
notes.notes: The game is now available in Italian! All thanks to the work of wonderful Mizraim. His diligence and enthusiasm will hopefully help introduce a lot more new Italian players to the world of Tiny Bunny. Kakihara, our Chinese translator, has also finished working on EP. 3. It is now available in Simplified Chinese.  We've also fixed a number of typos and missing lines in the English version of the game, as well as other general bugs. Thank you for being patient while we're still hard at work on EP. 4! Our top priority right now is to make sure future content for the game meets the quality bar we've set in previous episodes or maybe even surpasses it.

notes.title: Episode III
notes.notes:
Hello, Saikono here! Hurrah! it's finally the time! Our Bunny finally has a treat for you. We shoved this small present hidden under your Christmas tree (as late as it might be for our Western audience) so happy New Year!  The new episode will feature new new characters, more branching plot, as well as different outcomes depending on your choices in previous episodes, and also one small but curious addition: mini-games. Sadly, because of the engine's technical limitations, saves from the older versions of the game won't work in this one, so you'll have to replay everything up to EP. 3 manually or just skip the text by activating the "skip all text" option in the settings an pressing the Ctrl key. We're deeply sorry for this inconvenience. This whole year our team was working really hard at polishing the game and keeping and the quality bar as high as. Now then, we'll be holding our breath in anticipation of your reaction.[b] If you like the game, be sure to tell your friends about it (or maybe post about it on twitter, pretty please?). Your support matters a lot to us as a small indie team.[/b] Let's hope all of can us enjoy the upcoming year together! 
Cheers!

notes.title: Episode 3 release date!
notes.notes:
Yes, the title doesn't lie, this is the official announcement of the release date for Episode 3! We know you've been patiently waiting for more Tiny Bunny so we couldn't let ourselves delay the new episode into 2022. Which means, everyone who already owns the game will get it on December 31st, absolutely free of charge! 
The only sad news here is that, because of certain technical difficulties, your saves from the previous version won't work so you'll have to replay everything up to Episode 3, or manually skip the text by checking the 'skip all text' box in the options and pressing the 'Ctrl' key. We're very sorry about the inconvenience.

notes.title: 新版官方中文即将上线！
notes.notes:
各位中国玩家，大家好！
自游戏上线以来，我们就注意到一些玩家在测评里提到了官方中文质量不佳。非常感谢各位玩家的反馈！我们即将开始校对游戏的官方中文，努力给大家带来最好的游戏体验。后续的翻译校对将由中国译员Kakihara完成，确保译文的准确性和可读性。
最后，非常感谢大家喜欢我们的游戏！我们会努力在后续章节里给大家带来更多的惊喜！谢谢所有支持我们的中国玩家们！
